title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 2 Preview and Synopsis Revealed
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 2 (Episode 172 overall) ahead of its October 10 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The official Episode 2 synopsis:

Against the demon that suddenly appeared in the Spade Kingdom through Morris’s actions, Mereoleona displays an overwhelming amount of magical power. At the same time, the Magic Knights who have infiltrated Spade Castle split into three groups and challenge their respective rivals, the Dark Triad. Charlotte faces Vanica, host of the devil Megicula, the source of her curse, while Yuno confronts Zenon, who abducted Vangeance right before his eyes. Meanwhile, Jack and Nacht, though struggling, are managing to fight on equal terms with Dante, who wields the strongest Body Magic. There should still be plenty of time before the gates of the underworld open. Just when Nacht thinks so, the one who appears before him is…!!

You can see the preview images below:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!
author: Anime Corner

title: Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, New Character Trailer and Visual Revealed
content:
KAGURABACHI anime has cast Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, introducing the character with a new visual and dedicated trailer. Nakamura’s casting joins the previously announced main cast ahead of the anime’s April 2027 premiere.

Studio Cypic is in charge of the animation production, with Tetsuya Takeuchi as the director. Takeuchi is famously known for the Rock Lee vs Gaara fight in Naruto. We previously also had the chance to interview CyberAgent’s Takahiro Yamauchi , who talked about the company and its goal of creating “ high-quality Japanese animation works that can be accepted globally .”

The main staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Tetsuya Takeuchi

• Character Design: Keigo Sasaki

• Production: Cypic

Previously, the anime revealed the following voice cast:

• Taihi Kimura as Chihiro Rokuhira

• Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige Rokuhira

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Togo Shiba

• Miku Ito as Hinao

• Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi

Azami is a sorcerer affiliated with the Kamunabi and one of the few people aware of Chihiro’s existence, which had been kept secret. He is described as one of the organization’s strongest members, possessing extraordinary physical strength capable of overwhelming opponents with devastating blows.

Nakamura shared the following full comments about joining the series:

“Although there are still relatively few characters, I paid close attention to how he balances with the others. This should really pay off when a lot more characters start appearing later on…! I approached the role viewing him as someone who is serious, yet carries a bit of a dry demeanor.”

On being cast and his impressions of the anime, he said:

“I read the manga when I auditioned for the role, and I felt like it really embodied the recent ‘spirit of Jump.’ I couldn’t wait to see what would happen next, so I ended up reading every volume that had been released! I’m incredibly excited to see all those memorable scenes brought to life in the anime.”

Nakamura also commented on the original manga:

“Although it starts off with a dark atmosphere, the protagonist’s convictions and goals are clearly defined, making it really fun to read. The action may be what catches people’s attention first, but the worldbuilding, artistic sensibility, and unfolding story are equally captivating.”

On Azami’s appeal, he added:

“He strikes me as a realist who serves as a contrast to the romanticist Shiba. He’s compassionate, yet there’s something interesting about how he stays slightly detached. I think he’s a character whose appeal will become increasingly apparent as the story progresses.”

Asked to describe the series in one phrase, Nakamura answered:

“Incandescent!”

The anime is directed by Tetsuya Takeuchi, with Keigo Sasaki handling character design and Cypic producing the animation. Shochiku and CyberAgent lead the production committee.

Following premiere screenings at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, Japan Expo in Paris, and AnimagiC in Germany, the anime also screened at Otakon in Washington, D.C. on August 2, before concluding the tour at Anime NYC later that month. Part 2 of the tour is set for upcoming conventions in Johannesburg and Melbourne.

The story follows the young Chihiro, who was trained by his father to become a swordsmith. After his father is murderer, Chihiro sets on a path of revenge to avenge him with yakuza and sorcerers standing against him. The official synopsis:

Flames of resolve, kindled by hatred. Chihiro Rokuhira is a boy who aspires to become a swordsmith, and took daily training under his father Kunishige, a renowned swordsmith. Their days, once filled with laughter, are brutally torn apart by an attack from the mysterious sorcerer organization, the Hishaku. What is stolen from them are the six Enchanted Blades—swords of immense power capable of shaping the fate of the nation—and the gentle, warm life they once shared. From that day on, everything changed. In a world engulfed in darkness, Chihiro takes up Enten, the seventh Enchanted Blade left behind by his father, and sets out on a blood-soaked path of revenge.

The first teaser trailer for the anime exceeded 6 million views within the first 24 hours, and you can check it out below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Exclusive: Viz Hosts Signing Tour for GalaXic Baseball League Comic Artist Acky Bright
content:
Viz Media announced on Wednesday a signing tour across the United States for the GalaXic Baseball League comic series — Viz's collaboration with MLB Players, Inc., OneTeam Partners, and the BW NYC Studios of Japanese artist Acky Bright. The tour will start on October 13, the release date of the comic's first volume. The ticketed signing events will feature artist Acky Bright at Kinokuniya bookstores in New York, Chicago, Seattle, San Francisco, and Los Angeles. Attendees will also receive a special poster of the comic series.

Detailed schedules of the event are as follows:

• New York: October 13 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

• Chicago: October 14 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

• Seattle: October 16 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

• San Francisco: October 17 - 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.

• Los Angeles (Little Tokyo): October 18 - 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m.

• Los Angeles (Santa Anita): October 18 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

The GalaXic Baseball League series launched exclusively on the Viz Manga app on July 2.

Viz describes the comic's story:

In the distant future, baseball has rocketed into the cosmos. What was once America's pastime is now a high-stakes interplanetary competition in which teams from every corner of the universe battle for glory. Amid a sinister plot to wreak havoc on the galaxy, legendary baseball players team up with two unlikely heroes in their quest to save Earth – and the heart and soul of baseball.

Viz credits Acky Bright with the story for what it describes as the first such IP that includes active baseball players. The artist cites the 2023 World Baseball Classic final as the inspiration for the project. The series features baseball stars Shohei Ohtani (Los Angeles Dodgers), Yoshinobu Yamamoto (Los Angeles Dodgers), Aaron Judge (New York Yankees), Fernando Tatis Jr. (San Diego Padres), Jazz Chisholm Jr. (New York Yankees), Kyle Schwarber (Philadelphia Phillies), Paul Skenes (Pittsburgh Pirates), and more.

Acky Bright is a Japanese visual artist who has worked on projects for DC Comics and Marvel from his studios, including one in New York. He founded the design studio Brightworks in 2002. He was one among six artists chosen by Museum of Modern Art curator Paola Antonelli to demonstrate Japanese art to travelers to Japan. The Narita and Haneda Airports installed his manga-style video starting from February 2021. Acky Bright has designed merchandise for Hasbro 's Transformers franchise . He has collaborated with BMW of Germany on the title Heroes of Rivalry featuring e-sports teams Cloud 9, FNATIC, FunPlus Phoenix, G2 Esports, T1, and OG Esports. More recently, Acky Bright drew the illustrations for a limited-time campaign for WcDonald's.

MLB Players is the business arm of the Major League Baseball Players Association, which represents all professional baseball players of the 30 Major League Baseball teams in collective bargaining and licensing. OneTeam Partners is a joint venture of the NFL Players Association, MLB Players Association, Women's National Basketball Players Association, MLS Players Association, and U.S. Women's National Team Players Association for sports licensing, marketing, sponsorship, and media.
author: ANN

title: Walking Home with You Anime Unveils April 2027 TV Debut
content:
The official website for the anime of Mai Matsuda 's Walking Home with You ( Hōkago Kitaku Biyori ) manga opened on Wednesday and confirmed the anime's television format. The website also unveiled the anime's teaser visual and April 2027 premiere on the NTV channel.

The tagline on the visual above reads, "The requirement for joining the club is walking home with me."

Matsuda also drew a commemorative illustration:

Digital manga publisher Omoi licensed the manga and describes the story:

Shun was the star of his middle school's soccer team, until an injury forced him to give up on his dream. Now in high school, he's adrift, with no real interests or passions … until he meets his oddball upperclassman Naoki. She ropes him into joining her unofficial “Hyper-Epic Heading Home Club,” a club with only one member dedicated to turning every walk home into an adventure. As Shun follows Naoki through her flights of fancy in search of elaborate detours, secret treasures, and anything else that catches her attention, can the Heading Home Club bring color back to his drab everyday life?

The manga's anime adaptation was first announced in March 2025.

Matsuda launched the manga in Futabasha 's Manga Action magazine in August 2023. Futabasha will publish the seventh volume on Thursday.

Matsuda launched the Hikaru in the Light! manga in Manga Action in May 2021, and ended it in August 2022. Futabasha published four compiled book volumes for the manga. Omoi (then Azuki ) licensed the manga, and released all four volumes in English.

title: Code Geass: Lost Stories Game to End Service on December 7
content:
The official website for the Code Geass : Lost Stories social game announced on Wednesday that the game will end service on December 7. Sales of the in-game Sakuradite currency, Lost Stories Pass, and Starter Pack has also ended on Wednesday.

The game launched for smartphones as well as on PC via the DMM Game Player in May 2022. The game is free to play, with optional in-game purchases available. Rock band FLOW performed the game's original theme song "Pendulum."

The game's English version launched for iOS and Android in September 2023 and ended service in August 2024.

The action role-playing game had been originally slated to launch in winter 2018 as a PC browser game, but was then listed with no release window. DMM Games then announced in November 2021 that it was restarting the game's development process with f4samurai as the developers.

Game developer JORO launched the separate Code Geass Knightmare Survivor game for iOS and Android on September 15. The "survivor action" game is free to play, with optional in-game purchases.

The Code Geass franchise is celebrating its 20th anniversary this year and onward with several projects, including a new anime titled Code Geass Hoshi Oi no Aspal ( Code Geass : Aspal the Star Chaser), a new musical stage play , and an exhibition.

title: Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint Returns as Cygames and Breeders’ Cup Renew Partnership
content:
Cygames, Inc. has renewed its partnership with the Breeders’ Cup for the third consecutive year. Under the agreement, the weekend’s sprint race will be named the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint.

The Grade 1 race will take place on Saturday, October 31, at Keeneland Race Course in Lexington, Kentucky, as part of the 43rd Breeders’ Cup World Championships. It offers a $2 million purse and is open to Thoroughbreds aged three and older. The race is run over six furlongs (1,200 meters) on dirt.

The Breeders’ Cup announced that Cygames will have an “expanded on-site presence,” including photos and graphics of Japanese horses. Likewise, a life-sized statue of Forever Young will be displayed at the Keeneland Race Course. Cygames’ logo will be displayed on the starting gate and saddle towels of competing horses.

Heather Higgins, the Breeders’ Cup Senior Vice President of Corporate Partnership, said

“We are very pleased to continue our partnership with Cygames and build upon a relationship that connects two organizations with increasingly global audiences. Japan has become an important part of the Breeders’ Cup story, and Cygames has been a tremendous partner in helping us celebrate that connection in creative and engaging ways. We look forward to bringing their expanded activation to fans at Keeneland this fall.”

The 2026 Breeders’ Cup World Championships include 13 other Grade 1 races, in addition to the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint. Several Umamusume: Pretty Derby characters have placed or won in Breeders’ Cup races.

• Loves Only You — 1st place at the 2021 Breeders’ Cup Filly & Mare Turf, the first Japanese horse to win a Breeders’ Cup Race

• Marche Lorraine — 2nd place at the 2021 Longines Breeders’ Cup Distaff

• Forever Young — 1st place at the 2025 Longines Breeders’ Cup

Susumu Fujita, the chairman and founder of CyberAgent (Cygames’ parent company), owns Forever Young. While Forever Young will return to defend his title, no Umamusume: Pretty Derby horse will compete in the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint. General admission tickets start at $85 .

Cygames owns and created Umamusume: Pretty Derby. The multimedia franchise features anthropomorphic versions of real-world racehorses.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime's 1st Video Reveals Cast, More Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kuzushiro 's The Moon on a Rainy Night ( Amayo no Tsuki ) manga began streaming the anime's first full promotional video on Wednesday. The video announces the anime's main cast members, as well as more staff members.

The cast members include:

Iori Saeki as Saki Kindaichi

Sora Amamiya as Kanon Oikawa

The newly announced staff members include Seung Deok Kim and Tsutomu Tomoyuki as assistant directors, Haruko Nobori as the color key artist, Mai Ichioka as the art director, Atsushi Satō as the compositing director of photography, Masahiro Gotō as the editor, Nobuyuki Abe as the sound director, and jizue as the musical composer. CompTown president Masao Yamamura is also credited as animation producer.

Tomoe Makino ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , A Tale of the Secret Saint , Woodpecker Detective's Office ) is directing the anime at CompTown . Shōgo Yasukawa ( Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma , Mitsuboshi Colors , Rock is a Lady's Modesty is writing and overseeing the series scripts, and Ayumi Nishibata ( Otherside Picnic , Migi & Dali ) is designing the characters.

The anime will premiere in 2027.

One rainy night, Saki is rushing to a piano lesson when she crashes into a beautiful, long-haired girl, dropping her sheet music in the process. Saki stutters an apology, but the girl simply hands back her sheet music and leaves without a word. Saki begins her first day of high school the following morning, only to find the stranger from the night before sitting at the desk next to hers. She learns that the girl's name is Kanon and that she is not quite completely deaf, but very hard of hearing. Though Kanon needs to be close to people to read their lips, she tends to push people away with her icy demeanor. Through one kind gesture, Saki slowly begins breaking down the walls around Kanon, even as she feels something new blossoming within her.

title: Babanba Banban Vampire Manga Listed to Enter 'Final Stage'
content:
Dark Horse Comics licensed the manga, and will release the first volume in English on November 10. Dark Horse describes the manga:

An unassuming worker in a long-established public bathhouse is really the lustful 450-year-old vampire Ranmaru Mori! The heir to this esteemed Koi No Yu Bathhouse, Rihito Tatsuno, is a fifteen-year-old virgin—who is about to fall in love for the first time with a girl in his class! Ranmaru begins to weave a desperate plan to prevent Rihito from losing his virginity and to make him fall for Ranmaru instead, so the bloodsucker can eventually have pure, eighteen-year-old virgin blood for his own vampiric self!

Okujima launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine in October 2021. Akita Shoten published the manga's 14th volume on August 6.

The Baban Baban Ban Vampire anime adaptation premiered in Japan on January 11. The anime is streaming on Netflix .

A live-action film of the manga was originally scheduled for a February 2025 release, but was postponed due to "various circumstances." The preview screening scheduled in January 2025 was also canceled. The film opened in July 2025, and ranked at #5 in its opening weekend in Japan.

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Announced
content:
Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4: Founder of the Royal Academy’s So-Called Library Committee is officially getting an anime adaptation. The series’ official website announced the adaptation and confirmed that WIT Studio will continue the animation production.

J-Novel summarizes the first volume of part 4 as follows: Rozemyne has awoken from her two-year slumber. Everything and everyone has changed, which is as terrifying as it sounds, but she doesn’t have time to waste before she’s thrust toward the Royal Academy—a requirement for becoming a noble. There, she will meet all sorts of colorful teachers and students from other duchies… but can she keep her composure in the face of the most books she’s seen yet? Our bookworm goes to school in the newest installment of this biblio-fantasy by book lovers, for book lovers.

The first season of the anime aired in 2019, followed by a second in 2020 and a third in 2022, all animated by Studio Ajia-do. The latest Season aired in spring and summer 2026, with the last episode airing on October 3, 2026, and was animated by Studio WIT.
author: Anime Corner

title: You Are a Four Leaf Clover Romantic Suspense Manga to End in 12th Volume
content:
Retailers are listing the 12th compiled book volume of Koushi 's You Are a Four Leaf Clover ( Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ) manga as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 8.

The romantic suspense manga centers around Uichi, a once popular student who is now relentlessly bullied in high school. Still, he strives everyday to keep a promise to Yotsuha (his first love from elementary school before she transferred schools) to become a veterinarian. Just as he reaches his limit with the bullying, Yotsuha suddenly appears before him. She has seemingly not changed since back then — except she harbors only one hidden resolve deep in her eyes.

Koushi launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in July 2024. Akita Shoten published the manga's 11th compiled book volume on Wednesday.

The manga is inspiring an upcoming anime .
author: ANN
